hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'';process.stdout.write(f)}catch(e){}})" | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ]; then case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.json|*.md|*.css|*.html|*.yml|*.yaml) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" ;; esac; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
